faq_heading: Maple Ridge houses under $1.2 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Maple Ridge houses sell for under $1,200,000?
faq.a: 299 of 544, or 55%. 163 of them sold between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999.

faq.q: How much more does $1,200,000 buy than $1,000,000 in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: 163 more sales, 30% of the market. The share under the cap rises from 25% to 55%.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge areas have house medians near $1,200,000?
faq.a: Albion ($1,244,000, 78 sales) to Silver Valley ($1,421,500, 64 sales) are the 4 closest, for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is $1,200,000 enough for a house in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The median was $1,180,000, so $1,200,000 is 2% above it, and 55% of 544 sales closed under it.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,200,000).

In Maple Ridge, 299 of the 544 houses (55%) sold under $1,200,000: 136 for less than $1,000,000 and 163 more between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 179 sales.

The lower quarter of Maple Ridge houses sold at $999,975 or less, $200,025 under $1,200,000, and the upper quarter at $1,352,750 or more, $152,750 above it. A house at the cap would sit above the median.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,200,000 in Maple Ridge

The Maple Ridge median house was $1,180,000, so $1,200,000 sits 2% above it. Albion: $402 a square foot, built 2006, 78 sales. Northwest Maple Ridge: $487 a square foot, built 1987, 40 sales. Thornhill MR: $422 a square foot, built 2011, 14 sales. Silver Valley: $422 a square foot, built 2013, 64 sales. Check the roof age and foundation.
